selection_note: After the seed-3200 checkbox retest, this frozen checkpoint is evaluated on two related but previously unscored non-checkbox page variants at fresh seed 3400. Parent tab/collapsible pages were present in training or validation, so this is not independent task-family generalization.
success_criterion: For each evaluation page, correct action wins at least 70 percent of paired comparisons and weighted MSE beats both the frozen state-only model and unchanged-screen baseline. Missing page coverage fails the gate.
promotion: none; synthetic related-page transfer cannot establish real desktop dynamics, safety, or Jev parity
